property.name: boundField
property.description-key: Bind to any existing field on the form so the control can be added. Its value is never read or displayed -- every button acts on its own configured target fields instead.

property.name: saveOnClick
property.description-key: If enabled, saves the current record immediately after this button click sets its field values. When off (default), a click only sets field values in memory, the same as a user editing the form directly, and leaves saving to the user or to whatever automation runs on the form.

property.name: tileShape
property.description-key: The corner shape of each button

property.name: tileSize
property.description-key: Overall size of each button (padding, min/max width, and label text size). The icon itself stays a fixed size regardless of this setting

property.name: showLabel
property.description-key: Show the label text under the icon on each button. When off, the label is hidden and the icon is shown larger, centered in the button

property.name: iconPosition
property.description-key: Position of the icon relative to the label on each button. Has no effect when Show label is off, since the icon is always centered in that case

value.name: Left
value.description-key: Icon to the left of the label

value.name: Right
value.description-key: Icon to the right of the label

property.name: reflowBehaviour
property.description-key: Whether each button keeps a fixed width (Wrap, default -- buttons wrap onto a new row once they no longer fit) or sizes itself to exactly fit its icon and label (Flexible)

value.name: Wrap
value.description-key: Buttons keep a fixed width and wrap onto a new row when they run out of horizontal space (default)

value.name: Flexible
value.description-key: Each buttons width shrinks or grows to exactly fit its icon and label

property.name: makeFontBold
property.description-key: Display each button label in bold font weight

property.name: backgroundMode
property.description-key: Whether the resting background uses a single custom color for every button, or the accent color configured on each individual button

value.name: Fixed
value.description-key: Use the Button color property for every button

value.name: PerButtonColor
value.description-key: Use the accent color configured on each individual button

property.name: buttonColor
property.description-key: Resting background color of a button when Background color mode is Fixed color (hex, e.g. #FFFFFF)

property.name: hoverColor
property.description-key: Background color of a button while hovered (hex, e.g. #DEECF9)

property.name: activeColor
property.description-key: Background color briefly shown right after a button is clicked, as confirmation, before fading back to the resting color (hex, e.g. #C7E0F4)

property.name: borderMode
property.description-key: Whether buttons show a border, and whether it uses a fixed color or the accent color configured on each individual button

value.name: PerButtonColor
value.description-key: Use the accent color configured on each individual button

property.name: borderColor
property.description-key: Border color of a button when Border mode is Fixed color (hex, e.g. #D2D0CE)

property.name: iconColorMode
property.description-key: How icon color is determined for each button: automatic contrast against the button background (default), a fixed color, or the accent color configured on that button

value.name: Auto
value.description-key: Icon color automatically matches the button background for contrast

value.name: PerButtonColor
value.description-key: Use the accent color configured on each individual button

property.name: iconColor
property.description-key: Icon color used when Icon color mode is Fixed color (hex, e.g. #201F1E)

property.name: button1Label
property.description-key: Text shown on button 1. Leave blank to hide this button entirely.

property.name: button1Icon
property.description-key: MDL2 icon name (browse and copy names at https://www.flicon.io) or the name of a square image web resource, e.g. hek_MyLogo.png

property.name: button1Color
property.description-key: Optional accent hex color for this button, used when a color mode below is set to Per-button color

property.name: button1Tooltip
property.description-key: Optional tooltip text shown when hovering button 1

property.name: button1Actions
property.description-key: JSON map of target field logical name to the value to set on click, e.g. {"hek_status":"Approved","hek_approvedOn":"@{utcNow()}","ownerid":"@{me()}"}. A value wrapped in @{...} is evaluated as an expression; see documentation for supported functions, including me() for the current user. A JSON object with an id property, e.g. {"id":"guid","entityType":"systemuser"}, sets a lookup field. A multi-select choice field takes a comma-separated list of option values, e.g. 100000001,100000002. Any other JSON string/number/boolean/null is used literally.
